subject.title: Add GitNexus adoption and benchmark guide

question: Should this GitNexus/Voyage adoption guide land before the default-off hook in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/440 is accepted, or should it wait for that security-boundary decision?
rationale: Current main has no GitNexus hook, and this PR documents future credential, refresh, provider, stale-index, and secret-output handling that needs maintainer intent before it becomes core operational guidance.

options.title: Wait For Hook Decision
options.body: Merge this after maintainers accept or narrow the default-off GitNexus hook so the guide describes an approved security boundary.

options.title: Merge As Proposal Now
options.body: Land the docs now as an explicit adoption proposal, relying on the current wording that the hook is not current-main behavior.

options.title: Pause GitNexus Adoption
options.body: Keep or close the PR if maintainers do not want GitNexus/Voyage guidance in ClawSweeper core docs.

recommendation.title: Wait For Hook Decision
recommendation.body: Merge this after maintainers accept or narrow the default-off GitNexus hook so the guide describes an approved security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history around local review docs, toolchain scripts, and review/apply safety surfaces affected by this operational guidance.
